name: commontrace
description: CommonTrace knowledge base integration for Claude Code agents. Auto-searches for relevant traces at session start, provides /trace:search, /trace:contribute and /trace:brain commands.

api_key.title: CommonTrace API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank and an anonymous account is registered for you on first run — it can read, search and publish just fine. Set this only to contribute under an account of your own, so traces are attributed to it: claude plugin install commontrace@commontrace --config api_key=...
